title: Cedar-Plank Barbecued Salmon with Grilled Carrots & Seasonal Veg
originalTitle: Salmon barbecued on plank with grilled carrots and grilled other vegetable
ingredients: 1.5 lb wild salmon or steelhead fillet (or 4 individual fillets), skin-on
1 untreated cedar grilling plank (soaked in water for at least 1 hour)
1 tbsp Dijon mustard + 1.5 tbsp pure maple syrup or brown sugar
1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, kosher salt & black pepper
1 bunch asparagus or 2 medium zucchinis, halved lengthwise
1.5 tbsp olive oil and fresh lemon wedges
instructions: Soak the cedar plank in water for 1–2 hours. Preheat BBQ grill to medium-high heat (400°F).
Place the damp cedar plank on the hot grates for 2 minutes until it crackles lightly, then flip it over and place the salmon skin-side down on the toasted side.
Brush salmon with Dijon mustard, maple syrup, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Toss halved carrots and zucchini/asparagus with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Close the grill lid and smoke-roast the salmon on the cedar plank while grilling the carrots and vegetables alongside for 14–18 minutes until salmon reaches 125–130°F and carrots are tender-charred.
